page.layout: One column of running text, set in the middle of the page. Running head across the top, with the page number at the top right. Below the text: one ornament, which is not text. No marginal notes. The argument is set as a block paragraph within the column. The heading "INTERPRETATIO" is full width, above the text.

main_text.p: hereditate restituta, plus quarta retinuit, familiæ ercisc undæ iudicio illud restituere cogitur. L. Lucius Titius, 78, in fin. D. ad Trebell.
main_text.head: INTERPRETATIO L. FRATER À FRATRE, 39. D. de condict. indebit.
ARGUMENTUM.
main_text.p: Quod fratri aut patri naturali ex causa debitum, solutum erit, id ex ea parte tanquam indebitum condicetur, qua ex parte ad illos peculium pervenerit. participatio nanque peculii naturalem obligationem, qua ex parte illud acceptum est, extinguit.
FRater à fratre, cum in eiusdem potestate essent, pecuniam mutuatus, post mortem patris ei soluit: quęsitum est, an repetere possit. respondit,

page.notes: The running head is partly overprinted by a heavy stain at the top left; the words before FRATER A are illegible, and "A F." is read as printed. The page number is read as 311 and is uncertain. The "x" at the foot may be a gathering signature; it sits on the same line as the last word, so its position is uncertain. The word "condict." is printed with a ct ligature. "Quastionum" has a long s; the ae of Quæstionum seems to be missing and is marked [?]. The small dot below the text is an ornament, not text. The drop-cap F is joined to "Rater" as printed.
